title: The Real Cost of Owning a Classic Lamborghini
description:
A Lamborghini Countach Periscopio sold this year for eight hundred eighty-five thousand dollars. A Miura S V sold for more than three and a half million euros. But the price on the auction screen is only the start. One Countach, sold in Arizona, came with over sixty-eight thousand dollars of service invoices, and a single visit cost over sixteen thousand. This is the real cost of owning a classic Lamborghini. We will go through what the cars sold for new, what they sell for now, what the auction catalogues say about service, and what owners say, and we will be clear about which of those sources we trust. Every figure comes from a published source, listed in the description. Where we do the maths, we say so. Where we have no figure, we will not invent one.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
